scope: Explicit bounded fitting primitive plus full-resolution known-crop-shift diagnostic; not file/collection integration or calibrated acceptance
semantics: Only model fitting excludes out-of-range RGB. Residuals include every overlapping pixel; alpha never fitted. Existing APIs use no range and preserve defaults.
remaining: Range fitting is insufficient for CR2 render. Nonlinear clipping/render models, independent lookalikes, file integration and broad camera qualification remain open.
